title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as ridge regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This helps prevent overfitting by discouraging overly complex models.

title: Effect of L2 Regularization
text: The effect of L2 regularization is to shrink the coefficients of less important features towards zero, but not exactly zero. This helps in reducing model complexity and multicollinearity.

title: Choosing the Optimal Parameter
text: The optimal parameter in the context of L2 regularization is the one that balances the trade-off between fitting the training data well and keeping the model simple.
